body.x: Korea Non-ferrous Metals Co. Ltd. Introduced cost reduced ‘premium aluminum’ by participating at ‘2017 Korea Electronics Show(KES)’ which is hosted at Samsung-dong Coex for 4 days from 17th of October(Tues) to 20th(Fri).

Korea Non-ferrous Metals Co. Ltd. is a leading aluminum distributing enterprise as an aluminum specialized company with 30 years of tradition. It supplies high quality aluminum to all industries which need aluminum such as LCD, semiconductors, automobile, shipbuilding, aerospace, defense industry etc. It has acquired quality system for aviation/ defense industry, also it is the first company which acquired AS9120 certification.

Not only that, it sells its aluminum at a reasonable price to lighten the burden on its clients. This is achieved by shortening distributing process to save costs. Also, Korea Non-ferrous Metals Co. Ltd. offers a distinctive client oriented service to provide cutting/order production/storage services demanded by its clients, it also has largest domestic inventory to deliver its aluminum promptly.

Section chief of Also, Korea Non-ferrous Metals Co. Ltd.’s business strategy department, Jun-yeong Ahn said, “The goal of our company is developing with our clients, I hope more clients trust and use Korea Non-ferrous Metals Co. Ltd.’s products to achieve positive results.” Moreover, he ambitiously said that Korea Non-ferrous Metals Co. Ltd. will accelerate its efforts to export overseas.

Meanwhile, KES 2017, hosted by Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy and sponsored by KEA (Korea Electronics Association), is an international show where lots of potential buyers, governments, group officials participate, providing a good place to experience world first products like mobile phone, semiconductor, display, and next generation convergence solutions like industrial convergence, IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education and e health.
